Custom user-agent string is applied for single domain crawl

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_depth' => 0, 'stay_on_domain' => true, 'user_agents' => ['Mozilla/5.0 TestBot/1.0 (+http://example.com/bot)'] }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages[0].status_code.inspect
puts result.pages.length.inspect
```
